words.definition: An institution of higher education
words.definationTranslation: Uchcha Shiksha ka Sansthan

sentence.sentence: The university is located in the city center.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya shahar ke kendr mein sthit hai.

sentence.sentence: She graduated from a university in the United States.
sentence.translation: Vah America ke ek visvavidyalaya se snatak ki degree prapt ki hai.

words.definition: The courses offered by an educational institution
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan Sansthan dwara pradan kiye gaye pathyakram

sentence.sentence: The school curriculum includes mathematics and science.
sentence.translation: Is school ke pathyakram mein ganit aur vigyan shaamil hain.

sentence.sentence: The new curriculum will be implemented next year.
sentence.translation: Naya pathyakram agle saal lagu kiya jayega.

words.definition: A document awarded to a student on completion of a course
words.definationTranslation: Ek pathyakram poora karne par vidyarthi ko praapt kiya gaya dastavez

sentence.sentence: She received a diploma in nursing.
sentence.translation: Usne nursing mein diploma praapt kiya hai.

sentence.sentence: The university awards a diploma to its graduates.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya apne snatak ko diploma pratisthapit karta hai.

words.definition: A grant or payment to a student to help with their education
words.definationTranslation: Ek vidyarthi ko unki shiksha mein madad karne ke liye dya gaya anudaan ya bhugtan

sentence.sentence: She received a scholarship to study abroad.
sentence.translation: Usne videsh mein padhai karne ke liye chhatrvritti praapt ki hai.

sentence.sentence: The university offers scholarships to its students.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya apne vidyarthiyon ko chhatrvritti pradan karta hai.

words.definition: The ability to read and write
words.definationTranslation: Padhne aur likhne ki kshamata

sentence.sentence: The country has a high literacy rate.
sentence.translation: Is desh mein aksharata dar uchch hai.

sentence.sentence: The government is working to improve literacy among adults.
sentence.translation: Sarkar vaayaskon mein aksharata ko sudharne ke liye kaam kar rahi hai.

words.definition: The evaluation of a student's performance
words.definationTranslation: Ek vidyarthi ke pradarshan ka mulyankan

sentence.sentence: The teacher will conduct an assessment of the student's progress.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak vidyarthi ke pragati ka mulyankan karenge.

sentence.sentence: The school uses various methods of assessment to evaluate student learning.
sentence.translation: Is school mein vidyarthi ke shikshan ka mulyankan karne ke liye vibhinn tarike ka upyog kiya jata hai.

words.definition: A document that confirms a person has completed a course or achieved a certain level of competence
words.definationTranslation: Ek dastavez jo is baat ka praman karta hai ki koi vyakti kisi pathyakram ko poora kar chuka hai ya kisi vishesh star ki yogyata haasil kar chuka hai

sentence.sentence: She received a certificate in first aid.
sentence.translation: Usne prathamik chikitsa mein pramanpatra praapt kiya hai.

sentence.sentence: The university issues a certificate to its graduates.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya apne snatak ko pramanpatra jari karta hai.

words.definition: A person who gives individual instruction to a student
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo ek vidyarthi ko vyaktigat nirdeshan deta hai

sentence.sentence: The tutor helped the student with his homework.
sentence.translation: Guru ne vidyarthi ko uske ghar ka kaam karne mein madad ki.

sentence.sentence: She works as a tutor to support her family.
sentence.translation: Vah apne parivaar ko samarthan dene ke liye guru ke roop mein kaam karti hai.

words.definition: A person who gives guidance and support to a student
words.definationTranslation: Ek vyakti jo ek vidyarthi ko margdarshan aur samarthan deta hai

sentence.sentence: The mentor provided valuable advice to the student.
sentence.translation: Margdarshak ne vidyarthi ko mahatvapoorn salah di.

sentence.sentence: She found a mentor who helped her achieve her goals.
sentence.translation: Usne ek margdarshak paaya jo uski lakshyaon ko praapt karne mein uski madad ki.

words.definition: The act of registering for a course or program
words.definationTranslation: Ek pathyakram ya karyakram ke liye namanankan ki kriya

sentence.sentence: The enrollment process for the university is now open.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ke liye namanankan ki prakriya ab khuli hai.

sentence.sentence: The school has seen an increase in enrollment over the past year.
sentence.translation: Is school mein pichhle saal se namanankan mein vriddhi dekhi gayi hai.

words.definition: The grounds and buildings of a university or college
words.definationTranslation: Ek visvavidyalaya ya mahavidyalaya ke bhavan aur maidan

sentence.sentence: The campus is located in a beautiful area of the city.
sentence.translation: Parisar shahar ke ek sundar kshetra mein sthit hai.

sentence.sentence: The university has a large and modern campus.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ka parisar bada aur aadhunik hai.

words.definition: The teachers and professors at a university or college
words.definationTranslation: Ek visvavidyalaya ya mahavidyalaya ke adhyapak aur prachary

sentence.sentence: The faculty at the university are highly qualified.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ke adhyapak mandal uchch yogyata wale hain.

sentence.sentence: The faculty members are supportive and helpful.
sentence.translation: Adhyapak mandal ke sadasya sahayak aur sahaj hain.

words.definition: The people and processes responsible for managing a university or college
words.definationTranslation: Ek visvavidyalaya ya mahavidyalaya ka prabandhan karne wale log aur prakriya

sentence.sentence: The administration of the university is efficient and effective.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ka prashasan kushal aur prabhavshali hai.

sentence.sentence: The administration has implemented new policies to improve student life.
sentence.translation: Prashasan ne vidyarthi jeevan ko sudharne ke liye naye nitiyaan lagu ki hain.

words.definition: The courses and programs offered by a university or college
words.definationTranslation: Ek visvavidyalaya ya mahavidyalaya dwara pradan kiye gaye pathyakram aur karyakram

sentence.sentence: The university has a strong focus on academics.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya mein shikshan par majboot dhyan kendrit hai.

sentence.sentence: The academics at the college are rigorous and challenging.
sentence.translation: Mahavidyalaya ke shikshan kathor aur chunautipurn hain.

words.definition: The systematic investigation into a subject or topic
words.definationTranslation: Ek vishay ya vishay ke bare mein sankalpit janch

sentence.sentence: The university is known for its research in the field of medicine.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ausadhi ke kshetra mein anusandhan ke liye prasiddh hai.

sentence.sentence: The research center is conducting a study on the effects of climate change.
sentence.translation: Anusandhan kendra jalvayu parivartan ke prabhav par ek adhyayan kar raha hai.

words.definition: A meeting or conference for discussion and learning
words.definationTranslation: Charcha aur shikshan ke liye ek baithak ya sammelan

sentence.sentence: The university is hosting a seminar on entrepreneurship.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya udyamita par ek seminari ka aayojan kar raha hai.

sentence.sentence: The seminar was attended by students and faculty members.
sentence.translation: Seminari mein vidyarthi aur adhyapak mandal ke sadasya shaamil hue.

words.definition: A meeting or conference for practical training or discussion
words.definationTranslation: Vyavaharik prashikshan ya charcha ke liye ek baithak ya sammelan

sentence.sentence: The university is organizing a workshop on writing skills.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya lekhak kshamata par ek karyashala ka aayojan kar raha hai.

sentence.sentence: The workshop was led by a renowned expert in the field.
sentence.translation: Karyashala ka netritv kshetra mein ek prasiddh visheshagya ne kiya.

words.definition: A meeting of people with a shared interest or goal
words.definationTranslation: Ek saamanya ruchi ya lakshya wale logon ki baithak

sentence.sentence: The university is hosting a conference on sustainable development.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya sthayi vikas par ek sammelan ka aayojan kar raha hai.

sentence.sentence: The conference brought together experts from around the world.
sentence.translation: Sammelan mein duniya bhar ke visheshagya ekatrit hue.

words.definition: A talk or lesson given to a group of people
words.definationTranslation: Ek samuh ke logon ko diya gaya bhashan ya path

sentence.sentence: The professor gave a lecture on the history of science.
sentence.translation: Pracharya ne vigyan ki itihas par vyakhyan diya.

sentence.sentence: The lecture was attended by students from all over the university.
sentence.translation: Vyakhyan mein visvavidyalaya ke sabhi vidyarthi shaamil hue.

words.definition: A collection of books, journals, and other materials for reading and research
words.definationTranslation: Pathan aur anusandhan ke liye pustak, patrika, aur anya saamagri ka sangrah

sentence.sentence: The university has a large and well-stocked library.
sentence.translation: Visvavidyalaya ka pustakalaya bada aur samriddh hai.

sentence.sentence: The library is open to students and faculty members.
sentence.translation: Pustakalaya vidyarthi aur adhyapak mandal ke sadasya ke liye khula hai.
